title: Solventless polyester synthesis using a recyclable biocatalyst magnetic nanoarchitecture

The present study proposes enzymatic polymerization reactions to synthesize polyesters employing lipase (CaLB) covalently immobilized onto magnetic nanoparticles (i.e., Biocatalyst Magnetic Nanoarchitecture).
